deviation: The draft lets the Work Order override the Parent Agreement on Services, Fee, term and Deliverable, instead of the MSA always prevailing. This could let a Work Order dilute MSA liability, IP, data protection or audit terms (e.g., via Deliverable or Fee wording). It also drops the SOW tier from the hierarchy, and there is no fallback.
suggested_text: This Work Order is issued under the Statement of Work and the Master Services Agreement named above. If there is a conflict, the Master Services Agreement prevails, then the Statement of Work, then this Work Order. Capitalised terms not defined here have the meanings given in the Master Services Agreement.
